proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing behavior, owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds withdraw_review_requests()/pending_review_requests() GraphQL fallback logic to safely remove only automated pending requests when REST 422 bot-resolution occurs, with snapshot/history conflict checks and explicit failures; this is reviewer-assignment/approval automation, not PCCL runtime. Freshness gating is also workflow policy: .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py now validates saved classification by pr_number+head_sha and optional base_ref (dropping diff-fingerprint refetch), while review_automation.py persists base_ref in classify(); .github/WORKFLOWS.md documents that boundary. No independent CI/build/runtime module contract changes are evidenced.
